'''Saleucami town''' was a [[spaceport]] town that existed on the [[planet]] [[Saleucami]] at the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]]. Controlled by the [[Galactic Empire]], it contained an [[Saleucami impound dock|impound lot]] used by Imperial forces to hold seized [[starship]]s.<ref name="Cut and Run" /> Two [[Imperial Informational Station]]s<ref name="Cut and Run EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/cut-and-run-episode-guide|text="Cut and Run" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> had been set up in the town for security, one at the spaceport and the other at the impound lot.<ref name="Cut and Run" />
